These are some of the projects I worked on throughout my undergrad at Carnegie Mellon. During that time, I was mostly interested in using statistics to answer questions about psychology and human behavior, but I also got to work on projects covering other topics. I’ve kept these projects here as a record of the things I got to explore and how I’ve grown as a statistician.
